Comment: Experiment A / A2 zero-copy data plane benchmark. Single-node microbenchmark: one Task invokes cylon-armada-benchmark (10 GB Lambda), which runs the full serialization matrix and writes result CSVs to S3. No Map fan-out — the data axis is swept inside the Lambda, not across workers.

RunBenchmark.Comment: No Parameters block: the whole execution input is forwarded to the Lambda, which applies defaults for any omitted field. This avoids the SFN 'references a field the input does not send' failure for optional keys (batch_sizes, dims, etc.).
